#!/bin/bash
# postinst script for dpkg-wrapper
#
# See: https://www.debian.org/doc/debian-policy/ch-maintainerscripts.html

readonly dpkg_src=/usr/bin/dpkg
readonly dpkg_divert=/usr/bin/dpkg.orig
readonly dpkg_wrapper=dpkg_wrapper

readonly apt_src=/usr/bin/apt
readonly apt_divert=/usr/bin/apt.orig
readonly apt_wrapper=apt_wrapper

readonly apt_get_src=/usr/bin/apt-get
readonly apt_get_divert=/usr/bin/apt-get.orig
readonly apt_get_wrapper=apt_wrapper  # apt-get也使用相同的包装器

readonly package=dpkg_wrapper

ensure_wrapper_link() {
    local src newtarget real_file

    src=$1
    newtarget=$2

    if [ -z "$newtarget" ]; then
        return 0
    fi

    real_file=$(readlink "$src")
    if [ "$real_file" = "$newtarget" ]; then
        return 0
    fi
     #删除旧的绝度路径的软链接
    if [ "$real_file" = "/usr/bin/$newtarget" ]; then
        printf "replace absolute symbolic link %s -> %s.\n" "$src" "$real_file"
    fi

    ln -sf "$newtarget" "${src}.temp" || return 1
    mv -f "${src}.temp" "$src" || return 1
}

ensure_divert_backup() {
    local src dest newtarget real_file

    src=$1
    dest=$2
    newtarget=$3

    if [ -f "$dest" ]; then
        return 0
    fi

    real_file=$(readlink "$src")
    if [ -n "$newtarget" ] && { [ "$real_file" = "$newtarget" ] || [ "$real_file" = "/usr/bin/$newtarget" ]; }; then
        echo "warning: no $dest, keep existing wrapper link $src -> $real_file" >&2
        return 0
    fi

    if [ ! -e "$src" ] && [ ! -L "$src" ]; then
        echo "setup divert failed, neither $src nor $dest exists" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    cp -dp --preserve=xattr "$src" "$dest" || return 1
}

setup_divert() {
    local src dest newtarget diverter

    if [ "$#" -lt 2 ]; then
        echo "Usage: setup_divert <source> <destination> [newtarget]"
        return 1
    fi

    src=$1
    dest=$2
    newtarget=$3
    diverter=$(dpkg-divert --listpackage "$src")

    if [ "$diverter" = "$package" ]; then
        # Divert has already been set, ignoring it"
        ensure_divert_backup "$src" "$dest" "$newtarget" || return 1
        ensure_wrapper_link "$src" "$newtarget"
        return $?
    fi

    if [ -n "$diverter" ]; then
        echo "setup divert failed, $src diverted by $diverter" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    dpkg-divert --package "$package" --no-rename --divert "$dest" --add "$src" || return 1
    if [ -z "$newtarget" ];then
        mv "$src" "$dest" || return 1
    else
        cp -dp --preserve=xattr "$src" "$dest" || return 1
        ensure_wrapper_link "$src" "$newtarget"
    fi
}
echo "===postinst==="
case "$1" in
    configure|triggered)
        echo "configure|triggered..."
        if  ! setup_divert "$dpkg_src" "$dpkg_divert" "$dpkg_wrapper" ; then
            echo "setup dpkg divert failed"
            exit 1
        fi
        if  ! setup_divert "$apt_src" "$apt_divert" "$apt_wrapper" ; then
            echo "setup apt divert failed"
            exit 1
        fi
        if  ! setup_divert "$apt_get_src" "$apt_get_divert" "$apt_get_wrapper" ; then
            echo "setup apt-get divert failed"
            exit 1
        fi
        if [ -x /usr/sbin/kyexectl ]; then
			/usr/sbin/kyexectl -s /usr/bin/dpkg.orig
			/usr/sbin/kyexectl -s /usr/bin/dpkg_wrapper
            /usr/sbin/kyexectl -s /usr/bin/apt.orig
			/usr/sbin/kyexectl -s /usr/bin/apt_wrapper
            /usr/sbin/kyexectl -s /usr/bin/apt-get.orig
		fi
        ;;
    abort-upgrade|abort-remove|abort-deconfigure)
        ;;
    *)
        echo "postinst called with unknown argument \`$1'" >&2
        exit 0
        ;;
esac


exit 0

#!/bin/bash
# postrm script for dpkg-wrapper
#
# See: https://www.debian.org/doc/debian-policy/ch-maintainerscripts.html

readonly dpkg_src=/usr/bin/dpkg
readonly dpkg_divert=/usr/bin/dpkg.orig

readonly apt_src=/usr/bin/apt
readonly apt_divert=/usr/bin/apt.orig

readonly apt_get_src=/usr/bin/apt-get
readonly apt_get_divert=/usr/bin/apt-get.orig

readonly package=dpkg_wrapper

undo_wrapper() {
    local src dest diverter

    if [ "$#" -ne 2 ]; then
        echo "Usage: undo_wrapper <source> <destination>"
        return 1
    fi

    src=$1
    dest=$2
    diverter=$(dpkg-divert --listpackage "$src")

    if [ -z "$diverter" ]; then
        return 0
    fi

    if [ "$diverter" != "$package" ]; then
        echo "skip $src, diverted by $diverter" >&2
        return 0
    fi

    if [ ! -f "$dest" ]; then
        echo "undo wrapper fail, no $dest" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    dpkg-divert --package "$package" --no-rename --remove "$src" || return 1
    mv -f "$dest" "$src" || return 1
}

case "$1" in
    remove|purge)
        status=0
        undo_wrapper "$dpkg_src" "$dpkg_divert" || status=1
        undo_wrapper "$apt_src" "$apt_divert" || status=1
        undo_wrapper "$apt_get_src" "$apt_get_divert" || status=1
        exit "$status"
        ;;
    upgrade)
        ;;
    abort-upgrade)
        ;;
    *)
        echo "postrm called with unknown argument \`$1'" >&2
        exit 0
        ;;
esac

exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env python3

import gi
import traceback
import os
import sys

gi.require_version('OSTree', '1.0')
from gi.repository import GLib, Gio, OSTree, GObject

# 指定文件路径
file_path = "/ostree/pkgs/ostree-version.info"

def main():
    try:
        # 初始化 OSTree.Sysroot
        sysroot = OSTree.Sysroot.new(None)
        sysroot.set_mount_namespace_in_use()
        sysroot.initialize()
        sysroot.load()

        # 获取部署列表
        deployment_list = sysroot.get_deployments()
        if not deployment_list:
            print("No deployments found.")
            return

        # 遍历部署列表
        result = None
        for deployment in deployment_list:
            if not deployment.is_pinned():
                csum = deployment.get_csum()
                osname = deployment.get_osname()
                deployserial = deployment.get_deployserial()
                result = f"{osname} {csum}.{deployserial}"
                break

        if result is None:
            print("No unpinned deployment found.")
            return

        # 写入文件
        try:
            with open(file_path, 'w') as file:
                file.write(result)
            print(f"Successfully wrote '{result}' to {file_path}")
        except PermissionError:
            print(f"Permission denied when trying to write to {file_path}. Try running the script with sudo.")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"An error occurred while writing to file: {e}")

    except GLib.Error as e:
        print(f"GLib.Error occurred: {e}")
    except ImportError as e:
        print(f"ImportError occurred: {e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An unexpected error occurred: {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/bin/bash
diff_file=/etc/ostree/deploy_difflist
pending_commit=$(ostree admin status | grep "pending" | cut -d'.' -f1 | awk '{print $2}')
current_commit=$(ostree admin status | grep "*" | cut -d'.' -f1 | awk '{print $3}')

if [ x"$pending_commit" != x"$current_commit" ];then
    if [ ! -f $diff_file ];then
        touch $diff_file
    fi
    ostree diff $current_commit $pending_commit > $diff_file
fi

#After=network-pre.target dbus.service

#!/bin/bash 
#!/bin/sh
set -e 

unset DISPLAY

NEED_FACTORY_RESTORE=
for x in $(cat /proc/cmdline); do
    case $x in
        ostree-factory-restore)
            NEED_FACTORY_RESTORE=y
            ;;
        *)
            ;;
    esac
done

if [ x"$NEED_FACTORY_RESTORE" = "xy" ]; then
    /sbin/plymouthd --mode=shutdown --pid-file=/run/plymouth/pid --attach-to-session --kernel-command-line="quiet splash plymouth.debug"
    /bin/plymouth show-splash
    /bin/plymouth display-message --text="请再一次确认是否进行系统出厂还原，是否继续？[y/n]"
    is_sure=$(/bin/plymouth watch-keystroke)
    echo is_sure=$is_sure
    case $is_sure in
            y|Y)
                /bin/plymouth display-message --text="正在还原系统....."
                python3 /usr/sbin/kylin-ostree-restore.py
                sleep 3
                update-grub
                /bin/plymouth display-message --text="系统还原完成....."
                /bin/plymouth quit;;
            n|N)
                /bin/plymouth display-message --text="不恢复！....."
                sleep 10
                /bin/plymouth quit
                # # 注意，reboot重启不了，可用reboot -f
                reboot -f;;
            *) ;;
            esac
fi

# Copyright (c) KylinSoft  Co., Ltd. [2023].All rights reserved.
# [ostree-extra-utils] licensed under the [Your LICENSE].
# Author: [ZhangTingting]
# Create: [2024]

import gi
import traceback
import os,subprocess
gi.require_version('OSTree', '1.0')
from gi.repository import GLib, Gio, OSTree,GObject


def is_restore():
    with open('/proc/cmdline') as f:
        content = f.read()
        if "ostree-factory-restore" in content:
            print("restore")
            return True
    print("no restore")
    return False

def main():
    # 在这里编写主进程的代码
    print("这是主进程")
    ##先判断是不是恢复出厂模式
    if is_restore() == True:  ##是恢复出厂设置
        
        sysroot = OSTree.Sysroot.new(None)
        sysroot.set_mount_namespace_in_use()
        sysroot.initialize()
        sysroot.load()
        old_deployments = sysroot.get_deployments()
        # 部署的列表
        for i in range(len(old_deployments)-1,-1,-1):
            deployment = old_deployments[i]
            index = deployment.get_index()
            # 判断当前部署不是pin，则删除该部署
            if deployment.is_pinned() != True:
                
                print(f"NO-PIN-index=",index) 
                args = ["ostree", "admin", "undeploy",str(index)]
                subprocess.run(args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True) ##删除非pin、非hotfix部署
                print(f"Successfully undeployed")  
            ##删除分支后实际列表已变，但old_deployments未变，所以取消pin、创建新的pin需要重新reload

        ##重新load一次
        sysroot = OSTree.Sysroot.new(None)
        sysroot.set_mount_namespace_in_use()
        sysroot.initialize()
        sysroot.load()
        deployment_list = sysroot.get_deployments()
        for deployment in deployment_list:
            # 判断当前部署是pin，则取消该部署pin并重新部署该分支
            if deployment.is_pinned() == True:
                sysroot.deployment_set_pinned(deployment,False)
                osname = deployment.get_osname()
                bootcsum = deployment.get_csum()
                origin = deployment.get_origin()
                ret,my_deployment = sysroot.deploy_tree(osname,bootcsum,origin,deployment,None,None)
                #print(f"Successfully tree")
                sysroot.simple_write_deployment(osname,my_deployment,None,OSTree.SysrootSimpleWriteDeploymentFlags.RETAIN,None)
                # print(f"Successfully write")
                sysroot.deployment_set_pinned(my_deployment,True)
                print(f"Successfully pin")
                break

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/bin/bash 
osname=$1
csum=$2
deployserial=$3
bootcsum=$4
deploy_path=/ostree/deploy/${osname}/deploy/${csum}.${deployserial}
 
# 定义目标目录  
TARGET_DIR="${deploy_path}/usr/lib/modules"  
#TARGET_DIR="/usr/lib/modules"  ##在chroot环境内，环境外路径为：/ostree/deploy/openkylin/deploy/${commit_id}.0/usr/lib/modules

mount --bind /dev $deploy_path/dev
mount --bind /run $deploy_path/run
mount --bind /sys $deploy_path/sys
mount --bind /proc $deploy_path/proc
mount --bind /boot $deploy_path/boot
mount --bind /boot $deploy_path/boot

# 遍历目录下的所有子目录  
for ker_version in "$TARGET_DIR"/*; do  
	echo $ker_version
    if [[ -d "$ker_version" ]]; then  
        # 进入子目录  
        cd "$ker_version" || continue  
  		echo "dir="$ker_version
        # 获取子目录名称  
        subdir_name=$(basename "$ker_version")  
		echo "sub="${subdir_name}

        ## 进入deploy的环境并创建img文件
        chroot $deploy_path mkinitramfs -o /etc/initramfs-${subdir_name}.img ${subdir_name} -v
        initramfs_file=${deploy_path}/etc/initramfs-${subdir_name}.img
        if [ -s $initramfs_file ] && [ -e $initramfs_file ]
        then 
            cp ${deploy_path}/etc/initramfs-${subdir_name}.img  /boot/ostree/${osname}-${bootcsum}/
        fi
        echo "------------------------------"  
          
    fi  
done
